Neu k<1.0: lev=min(max(lev_s,0.25),1.0)=lev_s; notional=equity_hien_tai*lev; qty=notional/cand; cap=k*float(bar[volume]); neu qty<=cap -> fill tai cand; nguoc lai volcap_skip+1 va thu bar ke tiep trong expiry. Quyet dinh chi dung bar hien tai + equity qua khu (causal), tru luu y: full-bar volume ve ly thuyet chi biet sau khi bar dong (intrabar look-ahead nhe, ap dung dong nhat).
